purpose: Independent fault assertion and controlled recovery, without modifying the baseline frame PWM
scope: New 10-MOS GF180 6-V safety gate is pre-layout; it feeds the unmodified 12-MOS nominal selected-signal PEX. Recovery storage is RTL only. Safety rail, PG/body and neighbors retain ideal declared boundaries.

fault.assertion: fault high directly suppresses output without waiting for clock/frame; asynchronous RTL inhibit keeps fault memory
fault.default: initial asserted external fault; independent testbench 1-Mohm pull-up gives high on a disconnected fault input while safety rail is valid
fault.recovery: fault low plus explicit recover_request on a rising clock edge with pre-edge raw PWM low; fault deassertion alone cannot recover
fault.stopped_clock: fault assertion works while powered safety logic remains valid; recovery cannot proceed without a clock

threshold_rationale: 1 us uses one existing slot as a teaching deadline; 1 nA is the inherited numerical off guard, not a measured leakage/optical safety limit. 10 pC positive post-fault tail is a predeclared teaching ceiling of 10 percent of the ideal 100 uA x 1 us code charge. Signed tail and negative charge are reported separately. Fault interruption can deliberately shorten a pulse; the 950 ns normal-pulse guard is not applied to that interruption.
failure_policy: Keep raw failures. Adjust circuitry only with a recorded reason and new run identity; never silently change thresholds or overwrite earlier failures. Stopped-clock no-protection and synchronous-only protection are expected negative controls.
